title: Understanding the Sampling Frame
text: The sampling frame is the list or database from which a sample is drawn. It should include all individuals who could potentially be selected for the study.

title: Identifying the Sampling Frame
text: Consider the group of individuals Rachel had access to when selecting participants for the study. This group should represent the entire population she is interested in studying.

hintAnswer: All UC Berkeley students currently enrolled.
title: Defining the Population
text: Who are the individuals that Rachel is interested in studying for the BayPass Program?
choices: All UC Berkeley students currently enrolled.
The 12,000 students who received a BayPass card.
All people who use Bay Area transit services.
All BayPass card holders in the Bay Area.
UC Berkeley students who responded to the survey.

hintAnswer: All UC Berkeley students currently enrolled.
title: Linking Sampling Frame to Population
text: The sampling frame should include all individuals who are part of the population Rachel wants to study. What is this population?
